preflight.description: Manifest, mirror, locked toolchain, import, and environment isolation only.

quick.description: Short cross-layer smoke for core, meta, routes, and the current in-run surface.

core.description: All I0 characterization cases plus M6, G41, and M7 content/meta runtime gates.

ui.description: Headless UI routes, runtime contracts, and deterministic ART24 layout probes.

performance.description: Frozen I2 real combat workload baseline; headless CPU evidence only, with visible acceptance run separately.

full.description: Every registered blocking I1-V1 headless runner.
